summary: SQL assembly used AppendLine() (Environment.NewLine), so output was not byte-stable across OSes.
fix: Introduced a fixed NL='\n' constant + Line() helper; all script assembly now emits explicit LF. Added a test asserting no CRLF in output.

summary: Arbitrary #...# date literals were quoted blindly, risking silent locale-dependent meaning changes.
fix: #...# is now translated only when the inner value matches a strict ISO date/date-time regex; otherwise returns false (omitted + flagged). Added ISO-success and locale-ambiguous-failure tests.

summary: Hermetic tests missed several implemented branches/paths (binary/varbinary, missing-column FK drop, duplicate FK naming, identifier escaping; sanitize contract under-pinned).
fix: Added type-map InlineData for binary(9)/varbinary(17 sized+max); added FK missing-column-drop, duplicate-FK-name, identifier-escaping, and LF-newline tests; extended SanitizeCsvContractTests to pin RFC4180 quoting, header row, and file extension.

summary: Empty-FieldPairs relationship was silently skipped; CompareDegradations ignored Reason (unstable order for same Table/Column/Kind).
fix: Empty-FieldPairs relationships now produce a ForeignKeyDropped degradation; CompareDegradations now adds Reason as a final tiebreaker for a total order.
